sections.heading: About The Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba River House

blocks.text: The Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba River House provides addictions treatment and public education services related to alcohol, drug and gambling through 26 locations in communities across the province. TAF has been providing addiction treatment in Manitoba since 1977. Treatment are based on a comprehensive, multidisciplinary model that emphasizes individualized care and ongoing treatment.

TAF has been providing addiction treatment in Manitoba since 1977. Treatment are based on a comprehensive, multidisciplinary model that emphasizes individualized care and ongoing treatment.

blocks.text: Services include medication-assisted treatment (MAT), Partial Hospitalization Alcohol Treatment Program (PHAP) and Detoxification Programs. The Addictions Foundation is a member of the Canadian addiction treatment community and participates in Standards of Care developed by the Canadian Association for Addiction Research.

centre.about_html:
About The Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba River House

The Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba River House provides addictions treatment and public education services related to alcohol, drug and gambling through 26 locations in communities across the province. TAF has been providing addiction treatment in Manitoba since 1977. Treatment are based on a comprehensive, multidisciplinary model that emphasizes individualized care and ongoing treatment.

Services include medication-assisted treatment (MAT), Partial Hospitalization Alcohol Treatment Program (PHAP) and Detoxification Programs. The Addictions Foundation is a member of the Canadian addiction treatment community and participates in Standards of Care developed by the Canadian Association for Addiction Research.

Specialties

  • 12 Step Programs
  • Substance Abuse Treatmental
  • Residential Drug Rehab

Amenities

  • 12 Step Programs
  • Substance Abuse Treatmental
  • Residential Drug Rehab

Therapies

  • Holistic Therapy
  • Evidence-Based Practices
  • Yoga & Meditation
  • Individual Therapy & Counseling
  • Family Therapy & Counseling
  • Group Therapy & Counseling
  • Nutritional Counseling
  • Art & Nature Therapy
